scope: Reranker-only complete engineering-pool acceptance and offline input-length audit; not formal passage quality or full four-arm readiness

length_audit.method: CPU-only HF tokenizer from deployed pinned model, deployed native scoring template with query/document roles, render then encode with add_special_tokens=True and truncation=False; no labels used

formal.input_hash_scope: Parent input JSONL, including non-reranking tasks; only its 200 reranking pools were tokenized

engineering_acceptance.sampling_limitation: Nominal one-second interval plus sampling overhead; total GPU memory includes embedding. This is a sampled peak, not an exact peak or a no-interference guarantee.

conclusion.reason: Six complete pairs in six pools exceed the deployed 8192-token context; one also exceeds the pinned model's configured native 40960 positions. More engine VRAM budget does not change either limit.
conclusion.scope_guard: Do not truncate, discard pools, split candidates, extend context or change RoPE without an explicit protocol/deployment decision. The existing plan records length preflight failures separately, retains all original denominators, and reports common complete-input coverage separately.
remaining_formal_gates: Each refiner's complete-input/native-mode and engineering acceptance
